zh: 上周末我和朋友去爬山，虽然很累，但风景很美。
old_en: Last weekend, I went hiking with friends, though tired, the views were beautiful.
new_en: Last weekend, I went hiking with friends. Though we were tired, the views were beautiful.

zh: 上周末我带孩子去公园野餐，他玩得不想回家。
old_en: Last weekend, I took my child to the park for a picnic, and he played so much he didn't want to go home.
new_en: Last weekend, I took my child to the park for a picnic, and he played so much he didn't want to leave.

zh: 上周末天气很好，我们带孩子去公园野餐。
old_en: The weather was great last weekend, so we took our child to the park for a picnic.
new_en: The weather was great last weekend, so we took our child to the park for a picnic.

zh: 上周末几乎都在加班，所以周日我什么都没做。
old_en: I worked almost all last weekend, so on Sunday I didn't do anything.
new_en: I worked almost all last weekend, so on Sunday I didn't do anything.

zh: 上周末我们开车去看父母，因为很久没见了。
old_en: Last weekend, we drove to see our parents because we hadn't seen them in a long time.
new_en: Last weekend, we drove to see our parents because we hadn't seen them in a long time.

zh: 上周末我们去爬山，虽然下山时腿很酸，但大家都很开心。
old_en: We went hiking last weekend, although our legs were sore on the way down, everyone was still happy.
new_en: Last weekend, we went hiking. Though our legs were sore on the way down, everyone was still happy.

zh: 上周末我在家补觉，然后打扫了卫生。
old_en: Last weekend, I slept in and then cleaned up.
new_en: Last weekend, I slept at home and cleaned the house.

zh: 上周末我睡到中午，起来后把房间打扫了一遍。
old_en: Last weekend, I slept until noon and then cleaned the room afterwards.
new_en: Last weekend, I slept until noon and cleaned my room afterward.

zh: 上周末看了一部新片，故事不错，但结尾有点仓促。
old_en: I watched a new movie last weekend, which was good, but the ending felt rushed.
new_en: Last weekend, I watched a new movie. The story was good, but the ending felt rushed.

zh: 上周末我加了两天班，周日才休息。
old_en: Last weekend, I worked extra days, though I rested on Sunday.
new_en: Last weekend, I worked two extra days and rested on Sunday.

zh: 上周末在二手市场看到一把椅子，因为便宜就买了。
old_en: Last weekend at the second-hand market, I saw a chair and bought it because it was cheap.
new_en: Last weekend, I saw a chair at the second-hand market and bought it because it was cheap.

zh: 上周末我在家学做面包，结果烤糊了。
old_en: Last weekend, I was learning to bake bread at home, but it ended up burning.
new_en: Last weekend, I tried making bread at home, but it burned.

zh: 上周末下雨，我没出门，在家整理照片。
old_en: Last weekend it rained, so I stayed home and organized photos.
new_en: Last weekend it rained, so I stayed home and organized photos.

zh: 上周末我去看了一场电影，觉得一般。
old_en: Last weekend, I went to see a movie, but found it average.
new_en: Last weekend, I saw a movie and thought it was just okay.

zh: 上周末我去郊区看父母，吃了顿家常饭。
old_en: Last weekend, I visited my parents in the suburbs and had a home-cooked meal, although I usually don't go that often.
new_en: Last weekend, I visited my parents in the suburbs and had a home-cooked meal.

zh: 上周末我逛二手市场，买了一把旧椅子。
old_en: Last weekend, I went to the second-hand market and bought an old chair.
new_en: Last weekend, I went to the second-hand market and bought an old chair.

zh: 上周末我第一次做面包，虽然烤糊了，但味道还行。
old_en: Last weekend, I made bread for the first time, although it burned, it wasn't terrible.
new_en: Last weekend, I made bread for the first time. It burned, but it still tasted okay.

zh: 上周末我和朋友吃饭，聊到很晚才回家。
old_en: Last weekend, I ate dinner with friends and talked late into the night.
new_en: Last weekend, I had dinner with friends and talked until late.

zh: 上周末朋友请我吃饭，我们聊了很久。
old_en: Last weekend, my friend invited me to dinner, and we chatted for a long time.
new_en: Last weekend, my friend invited me to dinner, and we talked for hours.

zh: 上周末一直下雨，所以我待在家里整理照片。
old_en: It rained all last weekend, so I stayed home and organized photos.
new_en: It rained all last weekend, so I stayed home and sorted through photos.
